Arduino UNO R4 WiFi

Overview

The Arduino UNO R4 WiFi is the first UNO board to feature a 32-bit microcontroller and an ESP32-S3 module for Wi-Fi® and Bluetooth® connectivity. It features a RA4M1 series microcontroller from Renesas (R7FA4M1AB3CFM#AA0), based on a 48 MHz Arm® Cortex®-M4 microprocessor.

Pin Specifications

The UNO R4 WiFi has the following pin specifications:

  • Digital I/O Pins: 14 (of which 6 provide PWM output)
  • Analog Input Pins: 6 (A0-A5)
  • Operating Voltage: 5V
  • Input Voltage (recommended): 6-24V
  • DC Current per I/O Pin: 8 mA
  • Flash Memory: 256 KB
  • SRAM: 32 KB

Microcontroller Details

The board uses the Renesas RA4M1 (R7FA4M1AB3CFM#AA0) microcontroller with the following specifications:

  • 48 MHz Arm Cortex-M4 processor with FPU
  • 256 KB Flash / 32 KB SRAM / 8 KB EEPROM
  • 5V operating voltage
  • Real-time Clock (RTC)
  • Memory Protection Unit (MPU)
  • Digital Analog Converter (DAC)

Connectivity

Wi-Fi and Bluetooth connectivity is provided by the ESP32-S3-MINI-1-N8 module. The board supports Wi-Fi 802.11 b/g/n in the 2.4 GHz band and Bluetooth 5.0.
